name: Vehari

queries.query: Vehari Pakistan official cadastral parcel map land records Punjab PULSE PLRA
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Punjab PULSE public cadastral viewer, PLRA land-record authority, Vehari district administration, and Punjab village-wise cadastral-map service. The PULSE viewer explicitly lists Vehari and its current HTML configuration identifies a Vehari Feature Layer.

queries.query: وہاڑی پاکستان سرکاری کادستر نقشہ اراضی ریکارڈ پنجاب پلس
queries.result: First-party/native-language discovery returned the official Punjab PULSE viewer and Vehari district administration context. The viewer lists Vehari; the district administration page describes official land-record functions. No personal or ownership lookup was used.

officialSources.observation: Current official Punjab PULSE public viewer. Its unchanged HTML lists Vehari as sublayer id 37, identifies public ArcGIS service configuration, and displays the indicative-property-lines disclaimer.

First-party ArcGIS REST metadata for Vehari layer 37. Polygon layer; native spatial reference WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857; public fields include OBJECTID and other source attributes, which were not retained.
Official Vehari district administration page describes land-record administration and Khasra Girdawari functions; this is local/district custodian context.
Official Punjab Land Records Authority portal describing provincial land-record services.
Official Punjab village-wise cadastral-map procedure page; it exposes district, tehsil, village and year selectors but was not used for unsafe record lookup.

registryBasis: Official Vehari district administration land-record functions plus the Punjab PULSE/PLRA public cadastral viewer and Vehari-specific public layer establish a local/district-linked cadastral/map service. This does not establish legal title or citywide completeness.
service: Punjab PULSE / Punjab Land Records Authority ArcGIS public cadastral viewer

requests.outcome: Public viewer loaded; unchanged HTML inspected for current JavaScript/configuration, Vehari sublayer id 37, public service host, token bootstrap route, and disclaimer.
Public viewer session token issued and used in memory only; token value omitted from logs and artifacts.

Layer metadata returned. Schema and CRS inspected; only OBJECTID was requested from the feature query. Source fields such as District, Tehsil, Mouza, Khasra_ID, Khewat_ID and Remarks were not requested or retained.

Bounded exact-point intersects query at unchanged WUP coordinate [30.0461292688875,72.3537222073348], ArcGIS point order [72.3537222073348,30.0461292688875], where=1=1, outFields=OBJECTID, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326 returned one polygon with native OBJECTID 2616884. Geometry converted from service response to GeoJSON lon/lat for the retained sample.

uncertainty: Layer schema includes many source attributes, but only OBJECTID and polygon geometry were used. Native CRS is Web Mercator Auxiliary Sphere (WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857), while retained GeoJSON is EPSG:4326. Citywide completeness, update currency, legal status, survey accuracy, and linkage to authoritative legal records remain unverified.
